subject.title: fix: use invariant PT-PT formatting and update OpenClaw LKG

question: Should the Windows Setup Engine install OpenClaw 2026.7.1 by default before live Windows setup proof is attached and the linked gateway-start regression is resolved or shown not to affect this path?
rationale: Choosing a default LKG deliberately exposes first-run and repair users to a release-level availability risk; tests and npm tag status cannot determine the acceptable product risk.

options.title: Split the LKG bump
options.body: Merge the invariant-formatting work separately and keep 2026.6.11 pinned until dedicated Windows installer and gateway-start proof clears 2026.7.1.

options.title: Hold for live proof
options.body: Keep the combined PR draft until current-head fresh-install and upgrade evidence shows the 2026.7.1 gateway starts and remains usable through the Companion path.

options.title: Accept the release risk
options.body: Merge the 2026.7.1 default knowingly and own the possibility that some setup users will hit the documented gateway-start failure.

recommendation.title: Split the LKG bump
recommendation.body: Merge the invariant-formatting work separately and keep 2026.6.11 pinned until dedicated Windows installer and gateway-start proof clears 2026.7.1.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects him to both the prior formatting contract and setup/release integration decisions.
